title: Google's NotebookLM Now Turns Your Notes Into TikTok-Style Clips
hook: Studying from a pile of PDFs? Google's NotebookLM can now spit out a 60-second, vertical AI video summary of your sources — short-form video aimed at your reading list instead of entertainment.
key_points: NotebookLM can now generate 60-second, vertical AI video clips summarizing the sources you upload.
The feature is rolling out to Google AI Ultra and Pro subscribers.
It builds on NotebookLM's earlier trick of turning your documents into a podcast-style audio summary.
It's a sign that 'AI summarizes your reading' is moving from text and audio into short-form video too.
content_html: Google is adding a new way to catch up on your own notes: NotebookLM can now generate 60-second, vertical AI video clips summarizing the sources you've uploaded, The Verge reports. The feature is rolling out to Google AI Ultra and Pro subscribers.
extra_html: If the format sounds familiar, that's the point — it's the same short, vertical style popularized by TikTok, redirected at your reading pile instead of entertainment. It builds on a trick NotebookLM introduced earlier: turning a stack of PDFs or web pages into a podcast-style audio conversation you can listen to. Video is the next logical step, and it fits how a lot of people now prefer to absorb information — in short, digestible chunks rather than a full document. Whether a minute-long clip can do justice to a dense source is a fair question, but as a first-pass overview or a way to decide what's worth reading in full, it's a genuinely useful study trick.

related.title: AI as a Tutor
related.hook: A chatbot is a tutor with infinite patience: ask it to explain anything five different ways at any level, with no judgment. Just remember it can be confidently wrong.

related.title: AI That Sees & Hears
related.hook: Early chatbots only read and wrote text. Today's AI is 'multimodal' — one system can look at a photo, listen to your voice, and reply in words or pictures, the way people switch senses.

flashcards.prompt: What does NotebookLM's new feature generate from your uploaded documents?
flashcards.explanation_html: The new feature condenses your uploaded sources into a short, vertical-format AI-generated video clip, similar in style to a TikTok.

flashcards.prompt: Who can use this new AI video feature right now?
flashcards.back_html: Google AI Ultra and Pro subscribers, as the feature rolls out.

flashcards.prompt: What older NotebookLM feature does this echo, in audio form?
flashcards.back_html: NotebookLM already turned uploaded sources into a podcast-style audio conversation — this extends that same idea to short video.
